# Hold Shelf Management

## Placing an item on the shelf

You can reserve an item that is on loan or held at another branch. We will email you when it is ready to collect. When a requested item arrives, print a hold slip and fold it into the item so the name is visible from the spine. Items are on the hold shelf under your surname. Shelve items alphabetically by the borrower's surname. Bring your library card when collecting.

## How long an item waits

An item waits on the hold shelf for 7 days. Day one is the day we email you that the item is ready to collect, not the day it arrived.

## Clearing the shelf

Sweep the shelf every morning before opening. After 7 days, uncollected items go back into circulation or on to the next person waiting.

## Borrowers who cannot collect in time

If you cannot collect within 7 days, ask before the 7 days are up to have the item held for a further 7 days. This is granted once per request.

## Items nobody collects twice

If an item has been on the hold shelf twice without being collected under the same request, it goes back to the shelves and the request is cancelled; you will need to reserve it again.
